analysis.purpose: Reports used allocator memory for ten numbered levels, dumps the free list, and prints free/used header counts. Original format strings establish this purpose; individual level meanings remain uncertain.
analysis.observed_abi: a0 supplies an allocator-state address represented through its shared block prefix. Free and used anchors occupy self+0 and self+0x10; next pointers are at +4 and +0x14. Block+0 packs a level in bits 24..31 and 16-byte allocation units in bits 0..23. Per-level counts use signed halfwords. Signed 32-bit totals convert to float, divide by 1024.0f in f20, then promote to double. The original establishes no explicit return value; the void definition and import return declarations remain provisional.
